'''Bough Shadow''' {{co|90.3|40.1|Ashenvale}} is located in the northeastern corner of [[Ashenvale]], just beyond [[Forest Song]]. This place contains one of the portals to the [[Emerald Dream]]. Although the Emerald Dream is not implemented yet, the guardians [[Phantim]] and [[Dreamstalker]], along with other [[dragonkin]] guard it.

One of the four corrupted green [[Dragons of Nightmare]] - [[Emeriss]], [[Lethon]], [[Taerar]], or [[Ysondre]], will randomly spawn here on occasion. They are tough and require a [[raid]] to take down.
